About.title: Background & Engineering Workflow
About.backgroundText: Information Technology graduate from Universitas 'Aisyiyah Yogyakarta (GPA 3.51) with a published scientific journal from my undergraduate thesis on BBCA stock prediction using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). In industry, I completed an Excellent-rated Product Intern tenure at PT Aino Indonesia building an internal inventory dashboard, alongside leading entrepreneurship divisions at BEM FST and ITECH UNISA.
About.philosophyText: I combine AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate prototyping without sacrificing architectural clarity. Every system starts with mapping user journeys in Figma, followed by structured relational database modeling and thorough Black-Box verification before release.
